creation_serial.removal_selection: First strict maximum above zero, compared as signed WORD, among status1/3 records up to the cached high-water count. Negative/sentinel/wrapped serials remain excluded exactly as native.

known_native_quirks_retained: 00481210 fallback adds the selected horizontal shift a second time to published X and returned cell.
00487d00 returns a zero-based cell; its caller's existing result-1 transformation remains native behavior.
004f30b0 preserves full-EAX high bits from the tile-output pointer in mode5 and from the grid base in other modes; AL is1.
